problems.loads_sample_data: yes: seeded on start with PUB-01; About page File loads a case JSON; About page official/pack sample fetches the official pack (live API, then bundled data/P05_micro_loans_public.json). Case picker after load. Not hardcoded-only. Sample/File/Reset/Demo are not on the meeting toolbar.

R1.evidence: PUB-01 seed has 18 borrowers (≥15). Each has loan_bdt, interest_bdt, plan_weeks, instalment_bdt, first_due, and a different point in the cycle (paidWeeks/overdueWeeks mix). npm test TC-S01 TC-S02 TC-L05.

R2.evidence: Center meeting posts any amount on any date, including part (375.50) and overpay. Cash pad + typed input. TC-A01 TC-A02 TC-A09 TC-A10.

R3.evidence: Allocation is oldest unpaid week first; leftover carries forward. Passbook marks paid / part / overdue / due / upcoming per week. TC-L01–L10, TC-A05.

R4.evidence: Branch book: given out, collected, overdue; lists most overdue by amount and by weeks behind. PUB-01: given 14423500 paisa, collected 7563025, overdue 1847775. TC-L05.

known_limitations: JSON file store (local data/book.json; Vercel /tmp). A new serverless isolate may show the seed book again. Login is a signed cookie plus a bearer token so the officer is not kicked out.
Official live fixture API has no CORS for the Vercel origin; the app falls back to bundled pack JSON and file upload on the About page.
Payment correction is remove + recompute (log kept). Not a separate audit appendix.
Collection sheet matches 'this week' by calendar due date; other weekdays still show prior arrears.
Meeting-session cash is this browser sitting only; a refresh clears that tally. Posted payments remain on the server.
Login PIN is not printed on the login page.

R1.evidence: Separate repository; not combined with P05.
